Title: Bicycle Network Coverage
Label: Bicycle Network Coverage
Subtitle: Percentage of streets with bicycle lanes (bicycle lanes and protected bicycle lanes, excluding dirt trails, boardwalks, and velodrome tracks).
MethodsNote: Bicycle facilities within a 30-foot radius of each district is used to account for geographical measurement error. Data extracted from Safer Cycling: Bicycle Ridership and Safety in New York City report, available at http://www.nyc.gov/html/dot/html/bicyclists/bike-ridership-safety.shtml
indicatorDetail: Including bicycle lanes and protected bicycle lanes, excluding dirt trails, boardwalks, and velodrome tracks.
